component.name: Tauricord
component.summary: A lightweight desktop wrapper for the Discord Web App

description.p: Tauricord wraps the Discord web app in a native Tauri window, providing better OS integration, system tray support, and lower resource usage compared to the Electron-based Discord desktop client.

ul.li: System tray with close-to-tray, unread badge, and presence sync
Launch on boot and start minimized
Custom CSS support with live file watcher
Memory saver mode after configurable idle time
Voice chat via WebRTC (WebKitGTK with GStreamer)
Global hotkeys (Ctrl+Shift+M to mute, Ctrl+Shift+D to deafen)
External link interception — opens in system browser
